modern: Do wrong to yourself, do wrong to yourself, my soul; but you will no longer have the chance to honour yourself. Every man’s life is enough. But yours is nearly finished, though your soul does not respect itself, but places your happiness in the souls of others.
original: Do wrong to thyself, do wrong to thyself, my soul; but thou wilt no longer have the opportunity of honoring thyself. Every man’s life is sufficient. But thine is nearly finished, though thy soul reverences not itself, but places thy felicity in the souls of others.
